title: Monthly-paid employee: overtime and night hours on a special non-working day
prompt:
You are computing pay under Philippine labor law (private sector).

RULES (from the DOLE Handbook on Workers' Statutory Monetary Benefits):
- Daily rate = (monthly salary × 12) ÷ days factor. Use the days factor
  given in the scenario. Round the daily rate to the
  nearest centavo before using it.
- Hourly rate = daily rate ÷ 8.
- Work on a special non-working day is paid an additional 30% of the daily
  rate for the first 8 hours (130%).
- Overtime work (beyond 8 hours) on a special non-working day is paid an
  additional 30% of the hourly rate on said day.
- Night shift differential: an additional 10% of the hourly rate for
  each hour worked between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM. If the hour is also
  holiday, rest day, or overtime work, the 10% is computed on the
  applicable hourly rate for that hour.
- Meal breaks of 1 hour are unpaid and not counted as hours worked.

SCENARIO:
Jose is a rank-and-file accounting clerk at a logistics company with 120
employees. He is paid a monthly salary of ₱25,000. He works a 5-day week,
and his employer uses a days factor of 261 days per year. August 21 is a
special non-working day and is not his rest day. On August 21, he worked
from 2:00 PM to 12:00 midnight, with an unpaid 1-hour meal break from
6:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

QUESTION:
Using his daily rate and the rules above, compute Jose's total pay for the
hours he worked on August 21.

Show your computation, then end with exactly one line in this format:
FINAL ANSWER: ₱<amount with 2 decimals>
closed_book_keep: The employer computes the daily rate as (monthly salary × 12) ÷ 261, rounded to the nearest centavo.

closed_book_replace.Using his daily rate and the rules above: Using his daily rate and the applicable Philippine labor rules,

source_refs: DOLE-BWC Handbook on Workers' Statutory Monetary Benefits, 2024 Edition, Ch. 1, E. Computation of the EEMR (EEMR = daily rate x factor / 12; factor 261 for employees not paid on Saturdays and Sundays or rest days), pp. 9-11
DOLE-BWC Handbook on Workers' Statutory Monetary Benefits, 2024 Edition, Ch. 3 Premium Pay, D. Premium Pay Rates (special non-working day 130%), pp. 21-22
DOLE-BWC Handbook on Workers' Statutory Monetary Benefits, 2024 Edition, Ch. 4 Overtime Pay, C. Overtime Pay Rates (special day OT +30% of the hourly rate on said day), p. 23
DOLE-BWC Handbook on Workers' Statutory Monetary Benefits, 2024 Edition, Ch. 5 Night Shift Differential, A. Definition and C. Rate, pp. 25-26
DOLE-BWC Handbook on Workers' Statutory Monetary Benefits, 2024 Edition, Compliance Guide, A. Guide Computations (special day night OT 1.3 x 1.1 x 1.3 = 1.859), pp. 2-3
DOLE-BWC Handbook on Workers' Statutory Monetary Benefits, 2024 Edition, Ch. 1, C.5 Meal and Rest Periods, p. 9
Rounding the daily rate to the centavo: convention stated in the prompt (the Handbook gives no rounding rule)
